subtitle: Read and edit files in the per-agent working directories (`AGENT_CWD`).

noAgent.title: Pick an agent to browse its workspace
noAgent.description: Each registered agent runs from its own CWD. The picker lists every agent the registry knows about; the green dot next to a name means it reports available.

editor.noFile: Select a file from the tree to view or edit it.
editor.binary: This file looks binary (base64-encoded) — editing not supported.
editor.truncated: File is over 1 MiB; only the first 1 MiB is shown. Saving from here would replace the whole file with the truncated content — close without saving.
